C1421.title: Ethereum Sandwich Attack Detection Study: Over 560,000 Attacks Identified in Early 2024
C1421.summary: A 2024 study deployed a detection model to analyze Ethereum data from January to May 2024, uncovering more than 563,000 sandwich attacks, including 24,000 multi-attack instances, highlighting the prevalence of this exploit.
